name: Starlink Group 15-20
slot_a_text: SpaceX's 102nd launch of the year, 721st all time. 54th from SLC-4E this year, 3 days after the last one. The 200th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Falcon 9 is on a 327 flight success streak.
slot_b_text: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
